raw.transcript: First, move closer to your router so we know it’s not just a weak signal issue. Next, on your device, turn Wi-Fi off, wait about 10 seconds, then turn it back on. Then restart the router by unplugging it, waiting 15 to 30 seconds, and plugging it back in. After that, forget the network on your device, then reconnect and re-enter the password. If it still drops, try another device to see if the problem is the network or just one gadget. Finally, check for router firmware updates or interference from nearby electronics; if that’s tricky, your internet provider can help.
